defect_a: capture-guard.sh never copied or registered by --hooks
defect_b: per-event idempotency: first .proofpunk/hooks command in an event suppressed all siblings, so evidence-guard was silently dropped even before capture-guard existed

mutation_test.target: tools/proofpunk-install.sh ensure(): per-command idempotency reverted to per-event

failing_cases: evidence-guard.sh is on disk but absent from settings.json — dead guard
capture-guard.sh is on disk but absent from settings.json — dead guard
re-running --hooks was not idempotent: rc=0, capture-guard.sh occurrences=0

harness_coverage.why_plugin_tests_cannot_catch_this: A hook copied to disk but absent from settings.json is invisible from the plugin side; only driving the installer and reading the produced settings.json distinguishes registered from merely present.

preexisting_defect_note: The evidence-guard registration failure predates capture-guard: it has shipped dead in every --hooks install since evidence-guard.sh was written. Exposed, not introduced, by this change.
